Results - Main Analyses

GLMM analyses of the Preference Task and Valuation Task. Beware: - The code uses cache - chunks that had not been modified are loaded from the cache on knitting. - Some of the GLMM analyses might take a while to run.

Contrasts: Choice Set by Experiment (Day 1)

emmeans::emmeans(pref.chSet$glm ,~relative|expType,, at = list(Day.f=c("1"))) %>% 
  contrast("trt.vs.ctrlk",type="response",adjust="mvt") %>%   
  summary(infer=c(T,T)) %>% 
  transform(OR = odds.ratio %>% signif(.,3),
            LCI = asymp.LCL %>% signif(.,3),
            UCI = asymp.UCL %>% signif(.,3),
            z.ratio= signif(z.ratio,3), 
            p.value = round(p.value,3)) %>% 
 mutate(expType=relevel(expType,ref="E2"),
        expType=relevel(expType,ref="E1"),
        CI = paste0("[",LCI,", ",UCI,"]")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(expType, contrast, odds.ratio, OR, CI,z.ratio,p.value) %>%
  arrange(expType, contrast)

Preference Task: Contrasts: BC vs FG by Experiment (E3 vs E6)

pref.E3E6.acc.glm <- afex::mixed(resp.cor~expType*Day.f*ChoiceType.f+(1|partID),
                                data=data$preference %>% 
                                  filter(expType%in%c("E3","E6")) %>% 
                                  filter(ChoiceType.f%in%c("32","76")),
                                family="binomial",method="LRT", 
                                control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"))
